frontmatter.title: Production-Ready AI Versioning Strategies for Real-World Systems
frontmatter.subheading: From model and data versioning to reproducibility, rollbacks, and safe experimentation
frontmatter.excerpt: AI applications need more than Git tags to be production-safe. Learn proven versioning strategies for AI systems, including model lineage, dataset snapshots, prompt evolution, and environment locking to enable reliable deployments and rollbacks.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
